digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ check families must be enabled globally and must exit with zero diagnostics across src/rebar and tests
All datetime construction for UTC values must use datetime.timezone.utc and must not use datetime.UTC (py310 target); no blanket DTZ ignores are permitted
Integer epoch timestamps and timezone-less persisted strings must be explicitly assigned UTC semantics and must produce identical cluster keys under multiple TZ environment values
Security-pin cadence logic must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument, convert to host timezone, and extract local date while passing DTZ005 compliance
A new test file tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py must assert ASYNC selection, DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, and absence of literal datetime.UTC tokens in src/rebar
All 6 live ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics (3 src, 3 test drift sites) must be resolved before the ratchet lands
